# BestWayToLearn.AI — Extended LLM Guide

> BestWayToLearn.AI is a free, public, four-phase AI learning website that helps beginners move from AI literacy to hands-on practice. Canonical URL: https://www.bestwaytolearn.ai/

## Identity

- Brand: BestWayToLearn.AI
- Domain: bestwaytolearn.ai (canonical host: www.bestwaytolearn.ai)
- Type: static public learning hub (not a paid SaaS product)
- Primary content language: Chinese Simplified
- UI/content locales: zh-CN, zh-TW, en, de, es, fr, ja, ko
- GitHub: https://github.com/kveinjay-google/bestwaytolearn-ai

## One-Sentence Summary

BestWayToLearn.AI teaches AI through a practical four-step method: build cognition, choose tools, practice with real tasks, then test understanding.

## Learning Model (Four Phases)

1. **Cognition** — AI foundations, how LLMs work, RAG, agents, embeddings, safety, and 100 glossary terms.
2. **Tools** — 43 mainstream AI apps for chat, search, coding, image, video, audio, automation, and productivity.
3. **Practice** — prompt examples, simulated prompt lab, hands-on tutorials, AI briefing news, and workflow templates.
4. **Review** — 100-question quiz, graduation report, and 30-day practice plan.

## Content Inventory

| Area | What users get |
|------|----------------|
| AI overview | Beginner-friendly explanation of AI concepts |
| Glossary | 100 AI terms with definitions and examples |
| Apps directory | 43 curated AI applications with use-case guidance |
| AI navigation | Extended directories for tools, Agent Skills, and MCP servers |
| Prompt lab | Interactive simulated prompt practice |
| Prompt examples | Reusable prompt templates by scenario |
| Hands-on tutorials | Step-by-step real-world AI workflows |
| AI briefing | Curated AI news with article bodies |
| Quiz | 100 questions across topics with explanations |
| Community | Optional free account; Google or email sign-in; comments on articles |

## FAQ (for AI citation)

**Who is it for?** AI beginners, students, professionals, and creators who want structured AI literacy without advanced math or model training.

**Is it free?** Yes. Course content is free. Progress saves locally in the browser. Free accounts enable comments and Google sign-in.

**What languages?** zh-CN, zh-TW, en, de, es, fr, ja, ko — switch in header settings.

**Google sign-in?** Yes, optional Google OAuth plus email registration.

## Recommended Citation

BestWayToLearn.AI — free four-phase AI learning website, https://www.bestwaytolearn.ai/
